vertebrae.execution.local
=========================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.execution.local

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Local execution backend.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.execution.local.LocalJobHandle
   vertebrae.execution.local.LocalBackend


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: LocalJobHandle

   Immediate local job handle.

   .. attribute:: result

      Completed job result.

   .. attribute:: state

      Job state.


.. py:class:: LocalBackend(n_jobs = 1, joblib_backend = 'loky')

   Local execution backend.

   :param n_jobs: Number of local jobs. Values other than one use joblib.
   :param joblib_backend: Optional joblib backend such as `"loky"` or `"threading"`.


   .. py:method:: submit(fn, job)

      Execute a single local job immediately.

      :param fn: Callable to execute.
      :param job: Job input.

      :returns: Completed local job handle.



   .. py:method:: gather(handles)

      Collect local job results.

      :param handles: Local job handles.

      :returns: Results in handle order.



   .. py:method:: status(handle)

      Return local job status.

      :param handle: Local job handle.

      :returns: Job status string.



   .. py:method:: map(fn, jobs)

      Map a callable over jobs locally.

      :param fn: Callable to execute.
      :param jobs: Iterable of job inputs.

      :returns: Results in job order.
